text.p: Lithuanian newspapers carried the following reports in their Wednesday editions. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy:
ALL NEWSPAPERS
- Centre Union faction MP and former defence minister Audrius Butkevichius, 36, was detained on Tuesday while allegedly taking a $ 15,000 bribe from the director of the Dega service station chain.
Butkevichius denied the accusations and parliament will have to decide whether to strip him of his parliamentary immunity.
LIETUVOS RYTAS

- Homeland Union MP Emanuelis Zingeris said that the Simon Wiesenthal Centre's call for a boycott of the events to mark the 200th anniversary of the demise of the Gaon of Vilnius is an attempt to destroy the continuity of Jewish culture in Lithuanuia.
The centre said that it would be inappropriate for Israeli and American Jewish groups to take part in the events because of Lithuania's failure to try alleged war criminals on its soil.
- Ignalina nuclear power plant produced 7.242 billion kilowat hours of electric energy in the first seven months of the year.
RESPUBLIKA

- The administration of the president's office said on Tuesday that six more presidents expressed a wish to participate in an international conference on good neighbourly relations scheduled for the beginning of September in Vilnius.
The presidents of Latvia, Estonia, Lithuania, Belarus, Poland, Ukraine and the Russian prime minister
- The tender commission sent invitations to 20 foreign banks and firms to participate in the bid to become the government's advisor on Mazheikiu Nafta oil refinery privatisation.
- Hermis Bank posted a 16.3 million litas net profit for the fist seven months of the year.
LIETUVOS AIDAS
- Social insurance and pension fund's deficit in 1996 amounted to a record high of 731.3 million litas.
VERSLO ZINIOS
- The first half results of the banking sector showed that banks were growing and their financial ratios were improving.

- A poll carried out by the newspaper among the heads of operating banks showed that they consider Vilniaus Bank to be the best bank in the country. Hermis Bank was ranked second followed by the Lithuanian Savings Bank.
- Birzhu Dairy acquired a 40 percent stake in the Kauno Surine cheese producing firm and intends to invest around 3 million litas into the company.
- Dealers are bullish about the Vilnius bourse and say that bigger investors are coming to the market.
- Lithuania imported 3.157 tonnes of poultry in the first half of 1997, an increase of 14 percent compared to the same period in 1996.
-- Andrius Vilkancas, Vilnius newsroom + 370 2 22 35 18
